## About

Syed Mohamad Arif is a full-stack developer in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. He ships React Native apps, Next.js portals, and Node / Fastify services, including payments and bank payout integrations, and works AI-first with Claude Code skills, MCP integrations, and automation pipelines. Currently a Software Engineer (Mobile & Backend) at Paywatch Malaysia and available for freelance engagements with Malaysian SMEs, startups, and international clients.
